summary: Resideo Technologies filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated June 4, 2026, to facilitate the previously disclosed proposed spin-off of its ADI Global Distribution segment to common shareholders. The agreement provides up to $2.827 billion in senior secured financing, including term loan facilities totaling $2.327 billion and a $500 million undrawn revolving credit facility. The refinancing restructures existing debt ahead of the spin-off. No price, premium, or advisor details are provided. What to watch: regulatory approvals and the spin-off's tax-free status; risk-arb angle centers on the separation timeline and post-spin capital structure.
